svg.title: Ainekio: a companion with continuity
svg.desc: Interaction, decisions, attributed experience and reviewed learning connect over time. Intended design, not a fixed execution schedule.

g.text: Personality and relevant context inform each interaction.
Conversation, observations and events inform model choices.
Speak, express, act or pursue an objective.
Keep recent context, useful memories and task progress.
Preserve who said it, what happened, and what was imagined.
Curate experience and corrections; train and evaluate changes.
Use qualified improvements in later interactions.
Intended information flow · the complete companion loop is still in development.
